title: Precision oncology at the nanoscale: nano-optical biosensors for early cancer detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27358-27373
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02425D, Review Article

Nano-optical biosensors exploiting LSPR, SERS, FRET, and photonic crystals detect cancer biomarkers at femtomolar sensitivity from liquid biopsies, offering a transformative route to early, non-invasive precision oncology.
